reviews_captured_by_me.text: Jose Alberto and his crew were very knowledgeable. The work in my master bathroom was excellent. They were very clean and on time. Very responsive and  attentive. My bathroom had mold due to an old leak that we didn't know existed. The shower pan was completely broken. He put a new shower pan and fixed all the leakages. Installed the new shower pan, installed new bath accessories he recommended. They were beautiful. Lights above vanity are beautiful as well. Definitely if you are going to hire someone to do your bathroom he is the guy.

The before and after pictures speak for themselves. These gentleman were professional, timely, and fantastic at their job. We love to host friends and family and our guest bathroom is now something we can’t wait to show off. More than just beauty on the surface, there was attention to details and careful planning and execution of bathroom fundamentals. Everything works better than before with new pipes, enhanced drainage, comfort, and reliability throughout. We totally recommend!
Floor and bathroom construction INC  is the best company! They remodeled my bathroom floors. The best quality for the best price.
